class.description: 3D Scene Node rendering a `SphericalGoldbergPolyhedronResource` as a hex/pentagon planetary mesh with radial tile extrusion, bevel insets, spline-driven elevation/biome coloring, 3D raycast tile picking, and 3D spherical A* path visualization. Part of IdeamTiles (Wang/corner/edge tile sets, terrain rules, and procedural tiling).
